steps.name: When I log in as a manager with username "siri" and password "password"
Then I should be on the manager dashboard
Given an employee has a pending expense "Conference travel" for "450.00" in category "Travel"
When I view the pending expense queue
Then I should see the expense "Conference travel" with amount "450.00" in the pending queue
When I review the expense "Conference travel" as "approved" with comment "Approved, within budget"
Then I should see a confirmation that the review was submitted
And the expense "Conference travel" should no longer appear in the pending queue
